text: Gladys, they’ve got two pennyworth of pictures here, right enough.’ And then they go and look at more pictures and yawn and shuffle their feet and wish it was time to go home.” “Yet history has been made here once or twice, by all accounts.” “You’ve been listening to George,” said Bundle sharply. “That’s the kind of thing he’s always saying.” But Anthony had raised himself on his elbow, and was staring at the shore. “Is that a third suspicious stranger I see standing disconsolately by the boat-house? Or is it one of the house party?” Bundle lifted her head from the scarlet cushion. “It’s Bill,” she said.
